That feels safe and predictable. I typed "planning" and pressed Enter, and it created a brand-new "Planning" label — tidied up to a capital P even though I typed it lowercase — attached it to the bookmark as a chip, and added it to the sidebar with a count of 1. So a genuinely new label is easy to make when I mean to, and it won't fight me on capitalization.

I especially like that it only creates the new one when I deliberately press Enter. That's the reassuring part: it means when I'm just typing toward an existing label, it'll suggest the one I already have rather than silently spawning a near-duplicate, and I only get a new label when I clearly ask for one. That's exactly the balance I wanted so my labels don't quietly multiply.

I'm happy with that. What's next?
